title: Reviewed extraction expectation
description: Ground truth for a PDF (or set of its pages), established by a human inspecting the page images. Automatic extractor output belongs in an observation record instead. The schemas keep the kinds structurally apart (different record_kind, review block only here), but a person can still hand-edit status to reviewed: review is an attestation by the named reviewer, not something a schema can prove.

ordinal.description: Position of the entry within the printed reference list.

page.description: Physical page on which the entry starts.

truncated.description: Entry cut off at the scope boundary of a page-scoped record.

end_page.description: Page on which an entry that crosses a page break ends; required exactly when the entry's block chain ends on a different page than it starts; an end_page without page is rejected.

raw.description: Raw entry text exactly as printed.

doi.description: Printed DOI only. 'absent_in_source' (the entry prints none) is deliberately distinct from any extractor parse failure, which is an observation-side concept.

proposed_by.description: Tool/model that proposed the starting draft, if any. Informational only.

status.description: Only 'reviewed' records are ground truth; scorers must skip drafts.

reviewer.description: Opaque pseudonymous reviewer id (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen); not a personal name or address, and not the proposing tool.

basis.description: What the human compared against. Extractor output alone is not a basis.
